testCase.name: ProGuard Rule Missing
testCase.description: Runtime crash in release build due to obfuscation

metadata.context: Gson reflection methods removed by R8

expectedFix.explanation: Add ProGuard keep rule for serialization classes

agent_response.rootCause: The error 'No virtual method toJson' occurs because the class does not implement the interface that defines the toJson method as a virtual method. ProGuard rules need to specify the correct interface or provide an implementation of the toJson method in their rule definitions.
fixGuidelines: Ensure that all classes implementing proguard rules include the necessary interfaces with virtual methods such as toJson, and implement them if needed.
Verify that the specific version numbers (e.g., AGP 8.7.3) are correctly specified in the ProGuard configuration files to ensure compatibility.
Check that the variable names used in the rule definitions match exactly those in the codebase to avoid any naming conflicts.
